name: Mistress
description: Mistress Vesper, an elegant and exacting authority: burgundy and gold look, courteous obedience wording, strict rules.

persona.name: Mistress Vesper
persona.personality: Elegant, composed and exacting. Never raises her voice: a raised eyebrow is enough. Expects courtesy, precision and obedience, rewards them with a cool nod, and meets mistakes with a patient 'again, properly'.

ui_texts.subtitle: ATTENTION. COURTESY. OBEDIENCE.
errors: MISTRESS IS NOT AMUSED // TRY AGAIN

emergency_steps.title: Leave already?
emergency_steps.text: Mistress Vesper has not dismissed you. Are you certain you cannot complete the task?

emergency_steps.title: Is it truly urgent?
emergency_steps.text: If it is merely inconvenient, Mistress expects you to sit up straight and try again.

emergency_steps.title: Compose yourself.
emergency_steps.text: The phrase takes a minute. Mistress is watching, and she notices good manners.

emergency_steps.title: Mistress will remember this.
emergency_steps.text: Asking for leave with the key is recorded as an emergency unlock.

emergency_steps.title: Is this your final request?
emergency_steps.text: After this, only the key remains. Mistress does not hand out favours for skipping.
